name: Google Workspace Domain-Wide Delegation
description: Google Workspace Domain-Wide Delegation is an administrator-controlled service-account authorization pattern for impersonating domain users across selected Workspace API scopes.
agentUseSummary: This authentication pattern is visible as a canonical Google provider-family security preview. Relay will not collect service-account keys, bypass user consent, or create a shared impersonation runtime outside the typed Gmail, Drive, Calendar and other Google connectors.

capabilities.label: Use controlled Workspace delegation
capabilities.description: If a critical business case passes security review, extend only the relevant canonical Google connectors with fixed scopes and an explicitly approved domain-user allowlist.

blocked.label: Create duplicate Google provider state
blocked.description: Domain-wide delegation must not create a parallel tool or policy surface beside Relay's typed Google product connectors.

blocked.label: Upload a service-account private key
blocked.description: Relay will not accept a downloaded JSON key or other long-lived signing credential through this Marketplace setup alias.

blocked.label: Grant domain-wide delegation
blocked.description: Cloud project, service-account, API-scope and Admin-console authorization are high-impact super-administrator operations outside Relay agent actions.

blocked.label: Impersonate an arbitrary domain user
blocked.description: A generic subject field would let an agent select any user covered by delegated scopes and is not a bounded provider action.

blocked.label: Run Google APIs through this alias
blocked.description: All future delegated actions must remain in the relevant canonical Google connector with fixed scopes, subject policy, typed tools and product-specific audits.

approvalProfiles.label: Domain-wide delegation security review
approvalProfiles.description: This setup alias is not connectable. Domain-wide delegation bypasses user consent and remains unavailable until each canonical Google connector has a keyless, scope-fixed, subject-bound design.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; delegated support must extend the relevant canonical Google provider packs.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; delegated support must extend the relevant canonical Google provider packs.

providerSetup.blocker: Domain-wide delegation bypasses end-user consent, allows a service account to impersonate any in-domain subject covered by admin-granted scopes and can evade some ordinary user-domain policies. Relay's canonical Google connectors do not implement shared delegated impersonation.
providerSetup.nextAction: Prefer existing per-user canonical Google OAuth. For an approved critical case, use a dedicated Cloud project, keyless signJwt, fixed least-privilege scopes, immutable domain and subject allowlists, separate product connectors, super-admin grant evidence, audit correlation, emergency disable and periodic access review.

evidence.supports: Google documents service-account JWT authentication, super-admin domain-wide scope grants, explicit user impersonation through the subject claim and the fact that service accounts are not governed by ordinary Workspace user policies.

Google recommends avoiding domain-wide delegation when possible, limiting scopes, using dedicated projects, avoiding service-account keys, restricting IAM access and reserving delegation for critical business cases.
Google maps cross-domain user-data access to a super-admin domain-wide delegation grant and documents standard user-consent OAuth as the alternative.
Google documents that OAuth clients require manual Cloud-console configuration and should be audited and removed when unused; client creation is not a Relay runtime action.
